closureInvariants.statement: componentId remains an implementation/routing anchor and is not assumed to equal the diagnostic evidence subject.
evidenceSubjectKey is procedure-local unless independently promoted through existing architecture governance.
loadInstanceKey is used only when the source establishes distinct physical load instances.
path_open remains restricted to evidence satisfying the frozen Gate 6 through-load rules.

external_path_fault requires the existing Gate 6 evidence pairing and does not derive from positional switch tests, isolated harness continuity, voltage segmentation, or voltage-present/absent checkpoints.
physicalTestSetup describes the physical testing configuration; it does not itself create a diagnostic assertion.
repairTargetHint must remain source-grounded and procedure-local.
Subject-scoped conclusions must not automatically hard-score the routing componentId (except explicitly whitelisted fill_valve_coil routing per Gate 7A policy).
No canonical ontology node is created merely because a procedure contains an implementation-specific sub-function.
Existing legacy confirm/eliminate behavior remains valid where stronger scoped semantics are not established.
